name: orm-workbench
description: A deep dive into ORMs and hard relational design: build a small type-safe ORM from scratch (query builder, migrations, relations, unit-of-work) AND model a genuinely complex schema (multi-tenant, temporal/bitemporal, hierarchies, money, soft-delete) showing where the ORM helps and where you drop to hand-tuned SQL. Coordinates ORM internals with real database-design decisions.
